comment: The design is sleek and modern. I get compliments on it regularly. Doesn't look like a typical Electric bike at all.

title: Love the design
comment: The bell is louder than expected - in a good way! Pedestrians actually hear it first time.

title: Outstanding value
comment: Perfect for my hilly commute. What used to take 45 minutes of sweaty pedalling now takes 25 minutes and I arrive fresh.

title: Easy to use
comment: The motor provides smooth, natural assistance. You barely notice it working but hills that used to exhaust me are now effortless.

title: Feels very sturdy
comment: Wheels are strong and true. Haven't needed any adjustment despite some rough cycle paths and potholes.

title: Brilliant value for money
comment: Honestly couldn't believe the quality for under £400. Arrived well packaged, took about 30 minutes to assemble. The Shimano gears shift smoothly and the motor kicks in nicely on hills. Been using it for my commute for three months now and it's been faultless.

title: Great first Electric bike
comment: Bought this as my first Electric bike and I'm really pleased with it. The range is genuinely around 50-55 km which is more than enough for me. Only reason for 4 stars is the saddle could be comfier, but I swapped it out easily enough. Would recommend to anyone starting out.

title: Perfect for the countryside
comment: I live in the Cotswolds and this handles the hills like a dream. The front suspension is surprisingly good for the price point. Got the blue one and it looks cracking. Ozeco were really helpful when I had a question about the battery too.

title: Exceeded all expectations
comment: My husband bought one first and I was so jealous I ordered one myself the following week! We now go on rides together every weekend. The bike is sturdy, well-built and the battery lasts ages. Delivery was quick too.

title: Solid mountain bike
comment: Took this on some proper trails in the Peak District and it held up well. The disc brakes are responsive and the 21-speed gears give you plenty of options. Battery life is decent. Lost one star because the lights aren't the brightest, but that's a minor gripe.

title: Fantastic service and product
comment: From ordering to delivery, Ozeco made everything easy. The bike arrived within 2 days and was mostly assembled already. It rides beautifully and I love the red colour option. Highly recommended!

title: Replaced my car for commuting
comment: Since getting this bike I've barely touched my car. 12-mile round trip to work and back and still have battery to spare. It's saved me a fortune in petrol already. The bike feels really solid and well put together. Cracking purchase.

title: Really good entry-level e-bike
comment: Did loads of research before buying and this was the best value I could find. The motor assists well without being overpowering, and the bike looks much more expensive than it is. Comfortable ride overall, just wish the display was a bit bigger.

title: Christmas present success
comment: Bought this for my dad's Christmas present and he absolutely loves it. He's 62 and says the pedal assist has given him a new lease of life. Goes out cycling almost every day now. The grey colour looks really smart.

title: Can't fault it
comment: Three months in and this bike is still going strong. Use it 4-5 times a week for school runs and errands. The battery charges in about 5 hours which is fine overnight. Really comfortable ride and the suspension makes a huge difference on our bumpy roads.

title: Unbeatable at this price
comment: I've ridden Electric bikes costing twice as much and this genuinely holds its own. The TWOFISH TF1 is well-specced, rides smoothly and looks the business. Ozeco's customer service was top notch when I needed advice on tyre pressure. Five stars all day.

title: Love love love it
comment: Got the white one and it's gorgeous. Turns heads everywhere I go! More importantly it rides like a dream. The hills near my house used to kill me on my old bike but now I breeze up them. Best purchase I've made in ages.

title: Arrived fast, rides even faster
comment: Ordered on Monday, arrived Wednesday. Had it built and out on the road within an hour. The motor is punchy and the gears are smooth. Took it out for a 25-mile ride at the weekend and still had half battery left. Absolutely chuffed with it.

title: Great bike, minor niggles
comment: Really enjoying this bike overall. The ride quality is excellent and the range is as advertised. Two small things - the kickstand could be sturdier and the pedals are a bit basic. But for £400 I really can't complain. Would buy again.

title: Second one bought for the wife
comment: Bought mine in November and liked it so much I just ordered another for my wife. We've been exploring the countryside together every weekend. The battery easily handles 40-50km rides. Build quality is impressive for this price bracket. Ozeco are a pleasure to deal with.

title: Brilliant Christmas present to myself
comment: Treated myself to the M2 in December and I could not be happier. The motor is powerful enough for the hills near me and the battery lasts well over the claimed range on mixed terrain. Build quality feels solid. Very happy.

title: Fantastic bike, fast delivery
comment: Ordered just before Christmas and it arrived really quickly. My husband is absolutely delighted — he uses it for his commute and says it handles all types of road brilliantly. The motor assistance makes his hilly route effortless now.

title: Great all-rounder
comment: Really solid mountain e-bike for the price. I take it on trails and it handles well. Battery takes a few hours to charge but I knew that going in. Customer service from Ozeco was helpful when I had a setup question.

title: Better than expected
comment: Was a bit nervous buying an e-bike online but this exceeded my expectations. Arrived well packaged, took about 20 minutes to assemble, and rides beautifully. The assisted modes are perfect — I use eco for my flat commute and turbo when I need it.

title: Perfect for my commute
comment: Bought this in the January sales and it is the best purchase I have made in years. Cut my commute time in half and I arrive without breaking a sweat. Battery comfortably covers my 18-mile daily round trip on a single charge.

title: Solid e-bike, great value
comment: Happy with the M2. It is well built and the ride quality is really comfortable. The only reason I am giving 4 stars is the saddle could be a bit more padded, but that is easily changed. Otherwise excellent.

title: Got me back on a bike after years away
comment: Had not cycled in over a decade due to knee problems. The electric assist on this bike has got me back outdoors. Absolutely loving it. Easy to ride, powerful enough to take the strain off my joints, and looks great too.

title: Impressed from day one
comment: Everything about this bike is excellent. The hydraulic disc brakes are reassuring, the gears shift smoothly, and the electric assist is intuitive. Ozeco packed it very well and the delivery was quicker than expected.

title: Good quality, minor assembly tips needed
comment: The bike itself is great — smooth, powerful, and looks premium. Assembly instructions could be clearer in a couple of places but I found a YouTube video that helped. Would definitely recommend to friends.

title: Love it — use it every day
comment: Cannot believe how much I use this bike now. I was worried about riding in winter but the tyres grip well and the motor keeps things comfortable. Already planning spring rides. Brilliant buy from Ozeco.

title: Replaced my car for short trips
comment: Genuinely using this instead of the car for anything under 10 miles now. Saves on petrol and keeps me active. The range is excellent and the motor is quiet. Very glad I chose the M2.

title: Great bike, minor software quirk
comment: Ride quality is brilliant and I am genuinely enjoying cycling again. Had a minor issue with the display resetting but contacted Ozeco support and they sorted it quickly. Really good after-sales service.

title: Powerful motor, brilliant range
comment: Tested the range this weekend — got 42 miles on a mixed assist setting before needing a charge. Impressed. Hills that used to finish me off are now easy. The hydraulic brakes inspire real confidence on descents too.

title: Perfect for spring rides
comment: Just in time for the better weather — this bike is absolutely cracking. I have been out four times this week already. Smooth, responsive, and fun to ride. Quick delivery and great packaging from Ozeco.

title: Highly recommend
comment: My second e-bike and by far the better of the two. The M2 feels well engineered and the riding position is comfortable for long distances. I have already done two 30-mile rides and the battery had plenty left. Very happy with this purchase.

title: Handles everything brilliantly
comment: Bought this for commuting and weekend trail rides. The motor is powerful enough for the steep hills near me and the range is genuinely impressive. Build quality feels solid and the brakes are excellent. Arrived well packaged and was easy to put together. Highly recommended.

title: Absolutely love it
comment: This bike has completely changed my daily commute. Used to dread the hills but now I barely break a sweat. The suspension soaks up the potholes on my route really well. Great value for money and very well built. Delivery was quick too.

title: Very impressed overall
comment: Solid e-bike with a decent range. I've been getting around 55-60 km on a single charge on assist level 3 which suits me fine. The display is clear and the gears shift smoothly. Docking one star only because the seat took a little adjusting to get comfortable but that's minor.

title: Superb for the money
comment: Been riding this for six weeks now and it has been faultless. The Shimano gears make a real difference on varied terrain and the hydraulic disc brakes are very reassuring in wet weather. Battery charges overnight and I get a full week of commuting from one charge. Excellent.

title: Really enjoyable ride
comment: Loving this bike so far. Smooth power delivery from the motor and the display shows everything you need at a glance. Had a slight issue with the handlebar clamp on arrival but Ozeco's customer service sorted it quickly. Would buy from them again.

title: Exceeded my expectations
comment: I researched e-bikes for months before settling on the Touroll U1. It has not disappointed. The frame feels sturdy, the motor is quiet and responsive, and the range is as advertised. Delivery was fast and the bike arrived in perfect condition. Extremely happy.

title: Perfect for my daily commute
comment: Twenty minutes door to door and I arrive without being exhausted. The pedal assist is smooth and natural feeling, not jerky at all. Lights are bright enough for dark winter mornings. Saved a fortune on petrol since switching to this. Highly recommend Ozeco too — quick delivery and great communication.

title: Fantastic off-road capability
comment: Took this out on some local bridleways and it handled them without any trouble. The suspension does a great job and the tyres grip well on muddy surfaces. Back on the road it feels equally confident. Top quality bike for this price point.

title: Very happy with my purchase
comment: Great bike, looks smart in person and the build quality is solid. The battery life is excellent and I can easily do my commute twice on a single charge. Instructions for assembly could be a little clearer but I got there in the end. Overall very satisfied.

title: Brilliant all-round e-bike
comment: This ticks every box for me. Powerful motor, good range, quality components and a comfortable ride. The 29-inch wheels roll over everything with ease and the riding position is spot on. Ordered on a Tuesday and it arrived Thursday. Brilliant service from Ozeco.

title: Life changing for my commute
comment: This bike really has made a massive difference. Hills that used to leave me exhausted are now no problem. The pedal assist feels natural and the bike is very easy to control. Battery lasts all week on my commute. Absolutely worth the investment.

title: Solid reliable e-bike
comment: Been using this daily for two months and it's been completely reliable. The motor has plenty of power and the brakes are great. Range is honest — I get about 55 km in mixed conditions which is plenty for my needs. Well made and good value.

title: Love everything about this bike
comment: From the ordering process to the first ride, everything has been brilliant. The bike looks great, rides even better and the battery life is amazing. I've recommended it to two friends already. Ozeco were great to deal with — responded to my query within the hour.

title: Quality you can feel
comment: As soon as I unboxed this I could tell it was well made. The welds are clean, the finish is excellent and the components feel quality. First ride confirmed it — smooth, powerful and comfortable. The range is genuinely impressive. Very pleased with this purchase.

title: Great value, premium feel
comment: Just finished building this and I'm already impressed. Assembly was genuinely straightforward — took me under 30 minutes with the tools provided. For the price, the build quality is something else. Feels far more expensive than it is.

title: Can't believe the quality at this price
comment: For what you pay, this is genuinely outstanding. Looks and rides like a bike that costs twice as much. Put it together in about 40 minutes following the manual — no fuss at all.

title: Solid all-round e-bike
comment: Great on trails and tarmac. It's one of the more affordable options out there but you'd never know it from the quality. Really easy to put together too — clear instructions and everything you need is in the box.

title: Surprised at the quality for the price
comment: Assembled it in the garden in about 45 minutes. Everything went together perfectly. The finish and components feel premium — hard to believe this sits at the price point it does.

title: Best budget e-bike I've come across
comment: Budget price, premium quality — that's the best way I can describe it. First ride was great. Motor is smooth, gears shift well, and it looks fantastic. Assembly took me about 35 minutes.

title: Easy assembly, impressive quality
comment: Assembled it indoors the evening it arrived. Really simple process — maybe 30-40 minutes. The quality for the price is honestly remarkable. Feels solid and well made.

title: Cheap price, not cheap quality
comment: Don't let the price put you off — this is a seriously well built bike. Rides as well as some e-bikes I've tested at double the cost. Straightforward to assemble, clear manual and all tools included.

title: Very happy with this purchase
comment: Brilliant bike. You get a lot for your money — the build quality is way above what you'd expect at this price. Putting it together was easy, took about 30 minutes.
